nodes.label: Starlight's i18n collection warning can only be fixed in content.config.ts, not astro.config
nodes.norm_label: starlight's i18n collection warning can only be fixed in content.config.ts, not astro.config
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-fasttrack/2026-09-29 - investigate-i18n-build-warning [ses_f1223081fffersj7BE09yBYXjX].md:L2316] **Root cause:** `apps/learn/src/content.config.ts:5-7` defines only the `docs` collection. Starlight 0.42 unconditionally calls `getCollection("i18n")` at render time in `node_modules/@astrojs/starlight/dist/utils/translations.js:14` (`loadTranslations()`). Its `console.warn` mute around that call cannot suppress Astro's logger (Astro writes via its own destination, not `console.warn`), so Astro 7.3.2 logs from `node_modules/astro/dist/content/runtime.js:97`: `[WARN] [content] The collection "i18n" does not exist or is empty…`. No `astro.config.mjs` option can register a content collection — Astro syncs only `Object.entries(contentConfig.config.collections)` (`content-layer.js:221`), so stray dirs under `src/content/` are ignored and integrations have no collection-injection hook.

Proves stub is required (empty collection never populates the store key: `mutable-data-store.js:62` only creates the key on `set()`; sync calls `clear()` first).
